title: Rooftop Hot Tub Views  Parking Mins to Bway
description:
Elevate your Nashville experience when you book this four bedroom space located in the luxurious vacation rental community, The Lucy. This striking luxury home features highly stylized design with custom finishes and a private rooftop, complete with a hot tub, grill and skyline views! Nestled 3 miles from Downtown Broadway, East Nashville, and Germantown, this house is perfectly positioned between several of the city's most vibrant hotspots!

The space
★Highlights★
- Rooftop with Hot Tub + Skyline Views + Gas Grill
- 3 miles from downtown
- Professionally Decorated
- Fully Stocked Chef's Kitchen

★★Must Climb Stairs★★

Layout
★Level One★
2 Car Garage 2  (Trucks/SUVs longer than 21’6” will NOT fit in garage)
Laundry Room - Full Sized Washer + Dryer (pods and dryer sheets included)
Bedroom One - King Bed, Smart TV + Full ensuite Bathroom with Walk-in Shower + Double Sinks, Room Darkening Drapes

★Level Two★
Bedroom Two - Queen Bed, Smart TV + Room Darkening Drapes
Bedroom Three - Queen over Queen Bunkbed + Room Darkening Drapes
Bedroom Four - Queen Bed, Smart TV + Full ensuite Bathroom + Room Darkening Drapes
Hallway Bathroom - Full Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo 

★Level Three★
Kitchen - Fully Stocked, Gourmet Kitchen w/Island Seating + Dining Table + Coffee/Tea Station
Hallway Bathroom - Full Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo
Living Room with Queen Sofa Sleeper + Smart TV

★Level Four★
Rooftop - Dining Area, Soft Seating, Gas Grill + Hot Tub

Guest access
Guests have access to entire home except locked storage closets.

Other things to note
★★Must Climb Stairs★★ There are 3 FULL Flights of stairs in the house.
